summary: Archived arXiv TeX and PDF for 2606.02429.
Pinned the authors' companion repository at d7f91b16.
Confirmed SageMath 10.8 locally and Magma V2.28-3 remotely.
Verified the degree-3 source curve and cover identity in SageMath.
Derived the degree-3 symmetric base equation exactly.
Certified the quartic-to-Weierstrass birational transformation.
Verified that the explicit complementary map lands on E'.
Verified the exact denominator-product identity.
Executed the tracked Magma smoke artifact remotely; MAGMA_SMOKE_OK.
Created the private GitHub repository nasqret/isogeny_genus_2.
Remote Magma certified that the explicit complementary map has degree three.
Exact symmetric elimination and GCD reproduced the displayed singular model.
The reconstructed and Kuhn j-invariants agree at (3,4,5).
Four additional Kuhn-family parameter triples passed exact invariant comparison.
Derived the displayed degree-4 critical and genus-2 models from exact discriminants.
SageMath and remote Magma recovered the complementary degree-4 elliptic curve.
Identified the untwisted complement with Cremona 11a3.
Verified rank zero and torsion group Z/5Z for 11a3.
Computed the ramification j-invariant -27648/11.
Verified both generic degree-2 maps and their target equations.
Derived both critical-quartic j-invariant formulas symbolically over Q(p,q).
Verified nonconstant function-field points on both quadratic twists.
Certified the symmetric-square D4 invariants and defining relations over a universal sextic.
Verified the universal trace-method decomposition in symmetric coordinates.
Verified the generic quartic construction over Q(p,q) and cross-checked three fibers in remote Magma.
Certified squarefree normalization with explicit birational scaling.
Proved universal degree-3 linearity and the critical-quartic ellipticity criterion.
Certified dominance of the degree-2 j-pair map and infinite order of both twist points.
Audited the four symmetric-square equations and exact parametrization/GCD elimination pipeline.
Recovered the complementary rational map from exactly seven samples and verified it identically.
Independently reconstructed the degree-5 base field, curves, and degree-5 cover.
Disproved three printed degree-5 assertions and recorded corrected coefficients, genus, and a nonsingular Q(z)-point.
Remote Magma constructed the degree-two Gamma_p divisors and evaluated their classes by Riemann-Roch.
Remote Magma certified the S4 subgroup tower, intersection A4 cap Stab(1), and maximality proving primitivity.
Exact division-polynomial factors recovered all three exceptional ramification j-values.
Disproved the claimed degree-5 extension requirement; base-field Magma parametrization still gives j(E')=-250888806400/56807829.
Closed the article-wide audit: all 40 claims are terminal, evidence-linked, and machine-validated.
Proved the generic degree-5 three-node quartic and derived its normalization conic over Q(a,b).
Constructed ten exact primitive degree-5 maps; all tested conics split over the branch field and none over Q.
Certified a rational degree-7 Kumar benchmark by 41 exact Euler-factor identities.
Certified exact nonprimitive degree-20 and degree-80 maps by elliptic multiplication.
Recovered both primitive degree-7 maps over Q and certified their exact target and differential identities in SageMath.
Remote Magma independently constructed both Kumar morphisms and returned degree 7 for each.
Formal integration and exact Pade reconstruction reproduced both degree-7 X-coordinates from their eigenforms and target centers.
Generalized exact map recovery to arbitrary cover degree and certified degree-3, degree-5, and degree-7 cases with finite centers, quintic and sextic models, and a quadratic number field.
Automatically discovered exact differential scales and rational target centers for the degree-3 and both degree-7 maps using symbolic scale equations and bounded Mordell-Weil search.
From the degree-7 source and two family j-invariants, uniquely discovered twists -115 and 5, eigenform lines [1:0] and [0:1], and both exact maps.
Imported Kumar's Y_-(n^2) data for every degree 6 through 11 and constructed an exact nonsingular tautological genus-2 specialization in all six degrees.
Recovered both primitive degree-6 maps over Q; the complementary X-coordinate uses the full quadratic function field and its scale 2/3 was lifted from certified finite-field residues.
Remote Magma independently constructed both degree-6 morphisms and returned degree 6 for each.
Magma computed S6 monodromy for the degree-6 quotient; the elliptic-base square class is distinct from the unique quadratic subfield, so the cover remains S6 and is not exceptional PGL(2,5).

Recovered both primitive degree-8 maps at (r,s,z)=(4,-2,-1280); the complementary X-coordinate lies in Q(x,y) and its scale 2 was reconstructed modulo 61 and accepted by exact characteristic-zero verification.
Magma computed exact S8 monodromy for the compact degree-8 quotient; its discriminant square class differs from the elliptic-base class by -5, so the cover remains S8 after base change.
Remote Magma independently constructed both degree-8 morphisms, returned degree 8 for each, and proved that the source automorphism group has order 2.
Remote Magma independently constructed both degree-9 morphisms and returned degree 9 for each.
Recovered both primitive degree-9 maps at (r,s,z)=(3,-7,-29280); exact modular target-center searches lifted the finite infinity images with 128-bit and 184-bit CRT moduli.
Deterministic modular cycle types force S9 monodromy for the first degree-9 quotient; its linear discriminant square class is coprime to the elliptic branch cubic, so base change preserves S9.
Completed a resumable projective coefficient-CRT backend for rational X=A/D and full X=A/D+yB/D maps, with exact degree-6 characteristic-zero certification.

Recovered both primitive rational map pairs in degrees 10 and 11. All four X-coordinates use the full quadratic function field, and modular scale lifting reached 133/276-bit and 127/238-bit CRT moduli.
Remote Magma independently constructed all four degree-10 and degree-11 morphisms and returned degrees 10, 10, 11, and 11.

Remote Magma explicitly recovered the degree-6 and degree-8 splitting kernels as anti-isometry graphs. The graph matrices are [[1,4],[0,1]] mod 6 and [[4,7],[3,4]] mod 8, with 36 and 64 kernel points.

Completed the Galois-closure complement engine: exact fixed-field equations in SageMath, H_Z and H_W subgroup certificates in Magma, genus-one branch actions through degree 15, and concrete degree-6, degree-7, and degree-8 signatures.
Remote Magma computed S7 monodromy for the compact degree-7 quotient. Its discriminant square class is 2 times the elliptic cubic, so the elliptic base change remains S7.
Proved generic branch-field splitting of the degree-5 normalization conic by projecting the diagonal critical point; SageMath and remote Magma certify the closed-form point.
Derived the generic degree-5 complementary j as the binary-quartic invariant of the four orientation divisors, recovered the article value, and constructed quadratic examples over the branch field.
